related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver airtime table,compression definition and feature tests while retaining raw-data revision.
related.difference: 建立分階段累積輻射劑量帳，區分瞬時劑量率、累積劑量與元件驗證。
related.differenceEn: Build a phase-by-phase radiation-dose ledger and distinguish dose rate,cumulative dose and component qualification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先把 10 MB 轉 80 Mbit，再除 160 bit/s，換成日。

practiceEn: Convert 10 MB to 80 Mbit,divide by 160 bit/s and convert to days.

related.title: Curiosity 火星科學實驗室
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付回傳時間表、壓縮定義和特徵驗證，保留原始資料版本。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver airtime table,compression definition and feature tests while retaining raw-data revision.
related.difference: 以混樣質量平衡辨認真實成分與前一個樣品殘留。
related.differenceEn: Use mixture mass balance to distinguish composition from carryover of a preceding sample.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先把 10 MB 轉 80 Mbit，再除 160 bit/s，換成日。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成新樣本 20 mg、分析物 5%；殘留 1 mg、分析物 20%。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：C=(20×5+1×20)/(20+1)。 結果約 5.71429 %。量測濃度=(新樣品質量×濃度+殘留質量×濃度)/總質量；假設各成分均勻混合。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Convert 10 MB to 80 Mbit,divide by 160 bit/s and convert to days.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic new sample is 20 mg at 5%; residue is 1 mg at 20%. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: C=(20×5+1×20)/(20+1). Result ≈ 5.71429 %. Measured concentration is the mass-weighted mean of new sample and residue, assuming uniform mixing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
